description: This file defines the interface PropertySearchFilter, which specifies a filter for property searches within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to obtain the property path and the values used for filtering, as well as documentation comments describing its usage.

classes.name: PropertySearchFilter
classes.description: An immutable interface defining a filter for property-based searches, specifying the property path and values for matching.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JsonPointer representing the property path to be searched.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a collection of JsonValue objects that specify the values the property must match to be included in the search results.
